caller.name: GOLIATH-STAND-IN
caller.note: typed in-process caller; no GOLIATH control-plane spec exists in the repositories, so this is NOT the real GOLIATH

attacks.hypothesis: null is admitted as a receipt
an extra top-level trust field is accepted
ok=true with zero passed checks is admitted
a receipt without evidence is admitted
a receipt without result is admitted
evidence with its artifact list emptied is admitted
a flipped artifact digest (evidenceDigest untouched) is admitted
evidence whose artifact digest is wrong but whose evidenceDigest was recomputed (self-consistent) is admitted
self-consistent evidence bound to a different task digest is admitted
a KRATT action the envelope did not allow is admitted
a receipt claiming a different agent is admitted
a receipt and envelope for another repository are admitted
base_sha 000..0 in receipt and envelope is admitted
a receipt whose base_sha differs from the envelope is admitted
a real but stale commit (HEAD~1) as base_sha in receipt and envelope is admitted
a KRATT receipt claiming VERIFIED is admitted
evidence as an array is admitted
result.checks differing from the evidence are admitted
the identical valid receipt is admitted a second time
